TEXT.source: kanakanavu.info, "Mo'o 2014 Story 3", https://kanakanavu.info/language-documentation/moo-2014-story-3.html. This story was recorded by Ilka Wild in collaboration with Elizabeth Zeitoun in March 2014 in Namasia village. The speaker is Mo'o Kangena.

S.FORM: makai kari maku mison ia 'una kan cau miena.
S.PHON: makai ka[r|ɾ]i maku mison ia ʔuna kan ʦau miena
S.FORM: makai kari maku mison ia 'una kan cau miena.
S.PHON: makai ka[r|ɾ]i maku mison ia ʔuna kan ʦau miena
S.TRANSL: As for my speech I just told you about, there was a person long ago.

S.FORM: tee kan s<um>asʉrʉcʉ.
S.PHON: tee kan sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ
S.FORM: tee kan sumasʉrʉcʉ.
S.PHON: tee kan sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ
S.TRANSL: He was about to go to control (the traps 'ringei').

S.FORM: isua ia ka'an kanakanavu sumukun kan.
S.PHON: isua ia kaʔan kanakanavu sumukun kan
S.FORM: isua ia ka'an kanakanavu sumukun kan.
S.PHON: isua ia kaʔan kanakanavu sumukun kan
S.TRANSL: As for that (person), it was no Kanakanavu, it was a Bunun.

S.FORM: tee kan s<um>asʉrʉcʉ kan ringei makasi kan cacaan.
S.PHON: tee kan sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ kan [r|ɾ]iŋei makasi kan ʦaʦaan
S.FORM: tee kan sumasʉrʉcʉ kan ringei makasi kan cacaan.
S.PHON: tee kan sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ kan [r|ɾ]iŋei makasi kan ʦaʦaan
S.TRANSL: He was about to control the traps so he went on the street.

S.FORM: esi kan inia vii.
S.PHON: esi kan inia vii
S.FORM: esi kan inia vii.
S.PHON: esi kan inia vii
S.TRANSL: There was a cobra.

S.FORM: tee kan c<um>aca'ivi kan sua cau.
S.PHON: tee kan ʦumaʦaʔivi kan sua ʦau
S.FORM: tee kan cumaca'ivi kan sua cau.
S.PHON: tee kan ʦumaʦaʔivi kan sua ʦau
S.TRANSL: The person was going to pass the cobra.

S.FORM: mustaru'u kan mamia vii tia r<um>araisi.
S.PHON: musta[r|ɾ]uʔu kan mamia vii tia [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]aisi
S.FORM: mustaru'u kan mamia vii tia rumaraisi.
S.PHON: musta[r|ɾ]uʔu kan mamia vii tia [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]aisi
S.TRANSL: The cobra blocked the way to bite him.

S.FORM: mucaan kan saronai maica marakiu aracein.
S.PHON: muʦaan kan sa[r|ɾ]onai maiʦa ma[r|ɾ]akiu a[r|ɾ]aʦein
S.FORM: mucaan kan saronai maica marakiu aracein.
S.PHON: muʦaan kan sa[r|ɾ]onai maiʦa ma[r|ɾ]akiu a[r|ɾ]aʦein
S.TRANSL: He took an alternative route.

S.FORM: esi kan inia vii tia mustaru'u tia r<um>araisi.
S.PHON: esi kan inia vii tia musta[r|ɾ]uʔu tia [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]aisi
S.FORM: esi kan inia vii tia mustaru'u tia rumaraisi.
S.PHON: esi kan inia vii tia musta[r|ɾ]uʔu tia [r|ɾ]uma[r|ɾ]aisi
S.TRANSL: The cobra is there, blocking the way to bite (the man).

S.FORM: mu-una kan inia tupuru tee ci kita makinanu misei kan.
S.PHON: muuna kan inia tupu[r|ɾ]u tee ʦi kita makinanu misei kan
S.FORM: muuna kan inia tupuru tee ci kita makinanu misei kan.
S.PHON: muuna kan inia tupu[r|ɾ]u tee ʦi kita makinanu misei kan
S.TRANSL: He (the man) sat down. "What shoud I do?" he said.

S.FORM: esi ia una iisi cucuru iisi.
S.PHON: esi ia una iisi ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u iisi
S.FORM: esi ia una iisi cucuru iisi.
S.PHON: esi ia una iisi ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u iisi

TRANSL.notes: author suggests it = snake (source: "( The snake?)")

S.TRANSL: As for this, it was really there.

S.FORM: po'i kan na saronei makasi tanasa.
S.PHON: poʔi kan na sa[r|ɾ]onei makasi tanasa
S.FORM: po'i kan na saronei makasi tanasa.
S.PHON: poʔi kan na sa[r|ɾ]onei makasi tanasa
S.TRANSL: The man went back home.

S.FORM: miseen kasu po'i misa kan ucang-in ah kisʉʉn kan ucang-in.
S.PHON: miseen kasu poʔi misa kan uʦaŋin ah kisɨɨn kan uʦaŋin
S.FORM: miseen kasu po'i misa kan ucangin ah kisʉʉn kan ucangin.
S.PHON: miseen kasu poʔi misa kan uʦaŋin ah kisɨɨn kan uʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: "Why do you come back?" asked his wife.

S.FORM: natee kan s<um>asʉrʉcʉ ringei tia manan esi inia vunei mustaruvu akua ka'an tia moca misei kan.
S.PHON: natee kan sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ [r|ɾ]iŋei tia manan esi inia vunei musta[r|ɾ]uvu akua kaʔan tia moʦa misei kan
S.FORM: natee kan sumasʉrʉcʉ ringei tia manan esi inia vunei mustaruvu akua ka'an tia moca misei kan.
S.PHON: natee kan sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ [r|ɾ]iŋei tia manan esi inia vunei musta[r|ɾ]uvu akua kaʔan tia moʦa misei kan
S.TRANSL: "Originally I wanted to control the traps, but didn't know what to do, there was a snake blocked the way and I could not walk." he said.

S.FORM: anaka parirumʉʉn kisoo kan ucang-in.
S.PHON: anaka pa[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]umɨɨn kisoo kan uʦaŋin
S.FORM: anaka parirumʉʉn kisoo kan ucangin.
S.PHON: anaka pa[r|ɾ]i[r|ɾ]umɨɨn kisoo kan uʦaŋin
S.TRANSL: "You didn't chase it away?" asked his wife.

S.FORM: mucaan sua saronei po'i makasi kan cacaan.
S.PHON: muʦaan sua sa[r|ɾ]onei poʔi makasi kan ʦaʦaan
S.FORM: mucaan sua saronei po'i makasi kan cacaan.
S.PHON: muʦaan sua sa[r|ɾ]onei poʔi makasi kan ʦaʦaan
S.TRANSL: The man returned and went on the street.

S.FORM: esi inia vunei ni-mikasi kan mamia navung-in.
S.PHON: esi inia vunei nimikasi kan mamia navuŋin
S.FORM: esi inia vunei nimikasi kan mamia navungin.
S.PHON: esi inia vunei nimikasi kan mamia navuŋin

TRANSL.notes: rises hand and arm like a cobra

S.TRANSL: There was the snake, it's head was like that.

S.FORM: tia makatukutuku pacʉpʉcʉpʉng kan saronei ah pana-o tee mamia kan!
S.PHON: tia makatukutuku paʦɨpɨʦɨpɨŋ kan sa[r|ɾ]onei ah panao tee mamia kan
S.FORM: tia makatukutuku pacʉpʉcʉpʉng kan saronei ah panao tee mamia kan!
S.PHON: tia makatukutuku paʦɨpɨʦɨpɨŋ kan sa[r|ɾ]onei ah panao tee mamia kan
S.TRANSL: "I will hit it!" the man thought. "Ahhh, let's just shoot it!"

S.FORM: ni-mikasi kan sua navungʉ vii um-ʉsʉ kan tangkunga.
S.PHON: nimikasi kan sua navuŋɨ vii umɨsɨ kan taŋkuŋa
S.FORM: nimikasi kan sua navungʉ vii umʉsʉ kan tangkunga.
S.PHON: nimikasi kan sua navuŋɨ vii umɨsɨ kan taŋkuŋa
S.TRANSL: The cobra's head was like that, and (the man) charged bullets.

S.FORM: ecu'e kan inia.
S.PHON: eʦuʔe kan inia
S.FORM: ecu'e kan inia.
S.PHON: eʦuʔe kan inia
S.TRANSL: It (the snake) was targeted.

S.FORM: pana-'ei kan inia.
S.PHON: panaʔei kan inia
S.FORM: pana'ei kan inia.
S.PHON: panaʔei kan inia
S.TRANSL: It was shot.

S.FORM: s<um>apau kan hʉ'ʉr-in takuviri kan sua vunei.
S.PHON: sumapau kan hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in takuvi[r|ɾ]i kan sua vunei
S.FORM: sumapau kan hʉ'ʉrin takuviri kan sua vunei.
S.PHON: sumapau kan hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in takuvi[r|ɾ]i kan sua vunei
S.TRANSL: It's neck broke, the snake turned down.

S.FORM: takuviri kan sua vii.
S.PHON: takuvi[r|ɾ]i kan sua vii
S.FORM: takuviri kan sua vii.
S.PHON: takuvi[r|ɾ]i kan sua vii
S.TRANSL: The cobra turned down.
The cobra collapsed.

S.FORM: mucaan cu kan saronei isua.
S.PHON: muʦaan ʦu kan sa[r|ɾ]onei isua
S.FORM: mucaan cu kan saronei isua.
S.PHON: muʦaan ʦu kan sa[r|ɾ]onei isua
S.TRANSL: This man went away.

S.FORM: s<um>asʉrʉcʉ cu kan ringei akia kan ni-muringei.
S.PHON: sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ ʦu kan [r|ɾ]iŋei akia kan nimu[r|ɾ]iŋei
S.FORM: sumasʉrʉcʉ cu kan ringei akia kan nimuringei.
S.PHON: sumasɨ[r|ɾ]ɨʦɨ ʦu kan [r|ɾ]iŋei akia kan nimu[r|ɾ]iŋei
S.TRANSL: He controled the traps but nothing was trapped.

S.FORM: aaka cupʉng-in.
S.PHON: aaka ʦupɨŋin
S.FORM: aaka cupʉngin.
S.PHON: aaka ʦupɨŋin
S.TRANSL: He was sad.

S.FORM: nesiva ka'an pana-'ʉn vʉnei akia va ni-muringei kan makasi tanasa.
S.PHON: nesiva kaʔan panaʔɨn vɨnei akia va nimu[r|ɾ]iŋei kan makasi tanasa
S.FORM: nesiva ka'an pana'ʉn vʉnei akia va nimuringei kan makasi tanasa.
S.PHON: nesiva kaʔan panaʔɨn vɨnei akia va nimu[r|ɾ]iŋei kan makasi tanasa
S.TRANSL: He better had not shot the snake because without trapping anything he was going home.

S.FORM: akia ni-mururingei kisʉʉn kan ucang-in akia kan.
S.PHON: akia nimu[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]iŋei kisɨɨn kan uʦaŋin akia kan
S.FORM: akia nimururingei kisʉʉn kan ucangin akia kan.
S.PHON: akia nimu[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]iŋei kisɨɨn kan uʦaŋin akia kan
S.TRANSL: "You didn't trap anything!" his wife said, and there was nothing.

S.FORM: makasi cu mucaan tanasa saronei-in aranei inia musukʉʉm musukʉʉm sua saronei-in isua makanan.
S.PHON: makasi ʦu muʦaan tanasa sa[r|ɾ]oneiin a[r|ɾ]anei inia musukɨɨm musukɨɨm sua sa[r|ɾ]oneiin isua makanan
S.FORM: makasi cu mucaan tanasa saroneiin aranei inia musukʉʉm musukʉʉm sua saroneiin isua makanan.
S.PHON: makasi ʦu muʦaan tanasa sa[r|ɾ]oneiin a[r|ɾ]anei inia musukɨɨm musukɨɨm sua sa[r|ɾ]oneiin isua makanan
S.TRANSL: The man went on the road back home and since then he was sick. The man was sick and didn't know what to do.

S.FORM: musukʉʉm tunuka ka'an hʉ'ʉr-in makai ni-pana'ʉ kei vunei.
S.PHON: musukɨɨm tunuka kaʔan hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in makai nipanaʔɨ kei vunei
S.FORM: musukʉʉm tunuka ka'an hʉ'ʉrin makai nipana'ʉ kei vunei.
S.PHON: musukɨɨm tunuka kaʔan hɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]in makai nipanaʔɨ kei vunei
S.TRANSL: His ulceration, no , his neck hurt like the one of the snake he shot.

S.FORM: s<in>apau kei sua navung vii t<in>pau kan misei t<um>anarʉsʉ kan na ʉmʉce-in.
S.PHON: sinapau kei sua navuŋ vii tinpau kan misei tumana[r|ɾ]ɨsɨ kan na ɨmɨʦein
S.FORM: sinapau kei sua navung vii tinpau kan misei tumanarʉsʉ kan na ʉmʉcein.
S.PHON: sinapau kei sua navuŋ vii tinpau kan misei tumana[r|ɾ]ɨsɨ kan na ɨmɨʦein
S.TRANSL: He used to hit the head of the cobra, hit a hole (he thought) and perforated the cobra's throat.

S.FORM: sua tanaku makai kan ni-pana'ʉ kei vunei taraku.
S.PHON: sua tanaku makai kan nipanaʔɨ kei vunei ta[r|ɾ]aku
S.FORM: sua tanaku makai kan nipana'ʉ kei vunei taraku.
S.PHON: sua tanaku makai kan nipanaʔɨ kei vunei ta[r|ɾ]aku
S.TRANSL: His sickness hurt like the one he did to the snake.
The hole hurt like the one he did to the snake.

S.FORM: 'aranai cu inia cau isua sumuku ni ʉ'ʉ cau isua.
S.PHON: ʔa[r|ɾ]anai ʦu inia ʦau isua sumuku ni ɨʔɨ ʦau isua
S.FORM: 'aranai cu inia cau isua sumuku ni ʉ'ʉ cau isua.
S.PHON: ʔa[r|ɾ]anai ʦu inia ʦau isua sumuku ni ɨʔɨ ʦau isua
S.TRANSL: Since then the man was like that, it was a Bunun.

S.FORM: araaka.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aaka
S.FORM: araaka.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aaka
S.TRANSL: He died.

S.FORM: makasua sua kari.
S.PHON: makasua sua ka[r|ɾ]i
S.FORM: makasua sua kari.
S.PHON: makasua sua ka[r|ɾ]i
S.TRANSL: My speech is like that.

S.FORM: ka'aan purusʉvʉ cau iisi (a'a) pumanung kari iisi.
S.PHON: kaʔaan pu[r|ɾ]usɨvɨ ʦau iisi aʔa pumanuŋ ka[r|ɾ]i iisi
S.FORM: ka'aan purusʉvʉ cau iisi (a'a) pumanung kari iisi.
S.PHON: kaʔaan pu[r|ɾ]usɨvɨ ʦau iisi aʔa pumanuŋ ka[r|ɾ]i iisi
S.TRANSL: That person doesn't lie, these words are true.
I don't lie, these words are true.
